note: Public model files only. No user data. SHA-256 pinned in js/ml/*.js and checked before use on the device.

selfHosted.upstream: IS-Net / DIS 'isnet-general-use' (Xuebin Qin et al., https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS, Apache-2.0)

derivedFrom.file: isnet-general-use.onnx as distributed by rembg (https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg, MIT)

selfHosted.modifications: Kept only the main output; made input height/width dynamic (upsample targets now taken from the skip tensor's shape instead of constants traced at 1024); stored weights as float16 with Cast-to-float32 nodes (compute stays fp32); removed unused nodes. Box check vs original fp32 at 1024 on 18 sample photos: mask IoU mean 1.000 (min 0.9998) at 1024; 0.975 (min 0.82) at 640.

selfHosted.upstream: U^2-Net small (u2netp), Xuebin Qin et al., https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net (Apache-2.0)

selfHosted.use: fallback only, if IS-Net cannot load on the device
